name: riwi_projects
description: Dev tooling for markdown linting, link validation, and project.yml validation

scripts.lint:md: markdownlint-cli2 README.md CONTRIBUTING.md python/README.md webprojects/README.md ai_workflows/README.md docs/README.md docs/project-yml-contract.md
scripts.check:links: remark --use remark-gfm --use remark-validate-links --frail README.md CONTRIBUTING.md python/README.md webprojects/README.md ai_workflows/README.md docs/README.md docs/project-yml-contract.md
